name: command-base
description: Owner-approved new hero-base exterior. GPU front/three-quarter/back reviewed. Existing style-token materials; 8320 source triangles. Emissive surfaces included; bloom/light spill and playable interiors are later work.
brief: Complete connected hero headquarters from the owner's cropped base reference: large ivory/slate central pressure building, amber octagonal entry and stairs, low ribbed window wing, generic orange orbital badge, parabolic dish and twin lattice antenna towers. Closed exterior at real scale; independently named roofs, entry, doors, dish/support and antennas for future gameplay.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.
metrics.openSurfaceScope: Visible static open surfaces sampled at their vertices against visible static closed solids, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes open-vs-open pairs, motion, and any solid thinner than the sampled surface's facet spacing. Penetration within the contact tolerance is treated as intended contact, and penetration beyond it may still be intentional, as a fitting socketed into a shell is.

metrics.instanceabilitySummary: C (informational, not a QA verdict), set by 6 distinct materials (C at 4-6). Also: 90 geometries; 213 draw calls. Optional advice, not a requirement: merging smooth-structure:structure-gray + smooth-structure + dark-trim + accent-paint (differ in baseColorFactor, metallicFactor, roughnessFactor); emissive-warm + emissive-cool (differ in baseColorFactor, emissiveFactor, KHR_materials_emissive_strength) would leave 2 materials (B at 2-3).
